newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals largely steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals largely steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Copper and aluminium prices fell on Tuesday while other base metals were steady, dealers said.
Ready copper dropped 50 rupees to 12,250 rupees on fresh offerings by stockists and poor demand, they said.
Aluminium fell by 50 rupees to 7,250 rupees on reports that local producers were offering discounts to reduce inventories, said Sharad Parikh, president of Bombay Metal Exchange.

Tin was steady at 34,200 rupees and nickel at 36,700 rupees, traders said. They said zinc and lead were unchanged at 6,450 rupees and 4,450 rupees respectively. Overall sentiment was subdued at close of trade, they said.
